sloka: ततस्ते भ्रातर: सर्वे भृशमाश्वास्य राघवम् ।अब्रुवन् जगतीभर्त्तु: क्रियतामुदकं पितु: ॥ २.१०२.१७॥
transliteration: tataste bhrātara: sarve bhṛśamāśvāsya rāghavam ।abruvan jagatībharttu: kriyatāmudakaṁ pitu: ॥ 2.102.17॥

translations.english: All the brothers, having consoled Rama as best they could, told him, Let the libations be offered to our father, the protector of the world.
